_about: A reality-check script (R-33): written by `reality-check.js plan <bead>` from the story's criteria and probes into .delivery/reality-checks/<bead>.json, refined by the Delivery Manager, run by the Reality Checker on the real surface. Every result goes through `reality-check.js run-record`, which refuses a version on screen that is not the deployed one. Never put a password, token or secret in this file.

surface.install_artifact: <e.g. the connector from the shipped plugin zip>

account.name: <the test account's name: never the owner's own account, never a password>
account.signin: A sign-in, consent or payment wall stops the run: message the Chief of Staff with the one exact step for the owner queue (kind signin, consent or payment), and resume when it is done.

artifact.version: <the version string the deploy recorded (--version), or null>
artifact.read_on_screen: <where the surface shows the installed version>

preconditions: <owner-queue step ids that must be done first, e.g. the test account's long-lived sign-in>

setup.action: Open <app> on <host>, in <mode>, with <install artifact> installed, using the test account
setup.expect: the screen shows <app> in <mode>; any other app or mode stops the run

setup.action: Read the version the surface shows
setup.expect: <version or sha>; any other stops the run

criteria.criterion_hash: <written by plan; binds the group to the criterion's wording>
criteria.text: <the criterion, as the story states it>

steps.action: <what the persona does on the surface>

criteria.pass_rule: pass only when every step shows its expected observation on S1 at the version read in setup; anything else is a fail, recorded with its capture

always_capture: the version as the surface shows it
a screenshot or page text per step
the server log lines for the run window, with the caller's client and surface
